_about: 2-18 (R1 fix 1): antiportal_1138 (scale 3.6, 115.2 px at 32 x scale) covers block00_1141 and the
lift's foot, and antiportal_1237 (scale 3.9, 124.8 px) covers the door room with
anti_portal_agent_ent_1238 at its centre. The agent can be shot only from high over the upper floor
(y 54 or less) with door_lift_1146 raised, and button_1148 holds it up only while
crate_no_emissive_ent_1135 sits on it. Up the lower floor to block00 (portals at (32, 236), (150,
306), (348, 268), (80, 306)) and onto lift_ent_1142, and ride it. A portal over the button (320,
125) from the lift's top on 1670 and one beside the crate (68, 258) from its foot on 1757: the crate
enters the second portal as it opens (a crate already sitting in the first does not go), drops onto
the button on 1798, and the door rises. The lift's 175-tick shuttle and carranca_right_1075's 3000
ms stride drift 5 ticks a cycle, and the crate burns 60 ticks after the next fireball reaches it; at
this foot the rest fits before the door drops on 1928, and each earlier foot leaves 5 ticks less. A
portal at (255, 70) from the rising lift; left onto single_block_1208 and off its edge, a portal at
(365, 146) under the fall (1.3 px outside antiportal_1138's ring, 16 px clear of the crate); out of
(255, 70) up to (247.7, 33). The shot on 1892 toward (54, 76) passes 20.3 px from the agent (R17's
22.4) and 2.1 px over the settled barrel's corner (out/parity/program/R1/fix1/kill_2_18.txt): agent
and ring gone on 1908. A portal in the door room at (60, 30), over the barrel, on 1916 while the
door is still up, and one under the landed player (248, 146) on 1940; out at (60, 30), down onto the
door. Won on tick 1963. Leans on the port's traversal by body overlap (the crate; the player into
(365, 146) with his centre about 37 px from it, where the original's 14 px point test would take him
in lower and faster, to another apex and kill line; the player under a portal opened on him), on
R17's kill by a shot aimed into the field, on the fireball ending at the crate and burning it, and
on the carranca's fireballs crossing the closed door lift in this tree (no G5; on the merged build
they end at the closed door, which only takes the threat off the lift ride): re-verify on the merged
build.
